description: This file defines Flask API routes related to course catalog operations such as listing courses, listing lessons for a course, and searching courses by title. It creates a Flask Blueprint for catalog endpoints and interacts with database models for Course and Lesson.

classes.name: Course
classes.description: Model representing a course, with attributes like id, title, description, price_cents, created_by_id.

classes.name: Lesson
classes.description: Model representing a lesson, including attributes like id, course_id, title, content_url, order_index.

methods.name: list_courses()
methods.description: Handles GET requests to '/courses' that return a list of all available courses.

methods.name: list_lessons(course_id: int)
methods.description: Handles GET requests to '/courses/<course_id>/lessons' that list lessons for a specific course.

methods.name: search_courses()
methods.description: Handles GET requests to '/search' that query courses based on a substring match in the title.
